method: Actual cached production ConversationController/ConversationStore objects in two no-folder Ritemark extension hosts. Only synthetic fixture IDs are seeded. The audit driver calls host controller entrypoints without native model dispatch. A bounded per-Store filesystem wrapper pauses fixture record renames after the production revision check; delegates all bytes and IO unchanged. This proves a reachable storage interleaving, not its natural frequency or ordinary UI input timing.
